title: 2席の公園シーソー
description: 小公園向けの2席シーソーをわずかに傾けた静止姿勢で造形。座席、手すり、足掛け、1本梁、両側A型支柱、覆い付き軸受、地面側のゴムストッパーと固定金具を備えます。子供、地面や落下保護舗装は含みません。装飾用の静的メッシュで、動作・荷重・挟み込み・遊具安全規格は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.804 × 1.142 × 0.588 m、19,808三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A two-seat playground seesaw shown at a slight static rest angle, with seats, grab handles, footrests, one rocker beam, paired A-frame supports, covered pivot bearings, ground bump stops and anchor hardware. No children, ground surface or impact-absorbing surfacing. Decorative static meshes only; motion, loading, entrapment and playground safety standards are not validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.804 × 1.142 × 0.588 m; 19,808 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
